_doc: Task 6E section 10. Stage E0: overfit 20 deterministic records (10 same-image/different-target pairs) with the explicit spatial targets and measure the free-generation gate. A pass is implementation sanity only; it is not a generalization claim.

oracle_selection.rule: smallest B whose quantized oracle keeps paired 20/20 and strict mIoU >= 0.7206 (continuous oracle 0.7506 minus 0.03)

budget.note: Task 6D.1 section 2: the cosine horizon is the real optimizer-step budget, so the terminal factor is reached only at the final step.
